messages:
eli (New Hire): hi folks, starting next Monday (UK) — quick checklist Qs before my first paycheck: 1) when do company benefits start if you start mid-pay-period? 2) i got the private health enrollment email but prefer to stay on NHS, can i opt-out after enrolling? 3) i paid a relocation courier and visa admin fees — what paperwork for reimbursements? also my home-office allowance isn’t showing in payroll portal. thanks!
ruth (People Ops): welcome eli :wave: short answers: benefits effective date depends on start date — usually the 1st of the month after 30 days for mid-month starts. you can opt out of private health but we need a signed waiver. for relocation/visa receipts upload to HR portal under "expenses/relocation" and tag as "immigration" if visa-related. we'll route to payroll. i'll check the stipend visibility.
eli (New Hire): thank you! what about pension and auto-enrol dates — immediate or after a probation window?
aditi (Benefits): hi eli 12 welcome! pension auto-enrolment follows statutory rules: we enroll on the first payroll after you hit 3 months of service (that aligns with our policy). if you want to see projected deductions, i can send an example payroll stub.
eli (New Hire): uploaded files: courier_invoice.pdf, visa_fee_receipt.png, and added note "relocation - please reimburse" in portal. also tagged home_office_stipend_mismatch in the payroll portal ticket system.
hr-portal-bot: Received uploads: courier_invoice.pdf, visa_fee_receipt.png. Ticket created: HR-EXP-1827. Please include "employee-id" in ticket comments for faster processing.
mike (Payroll): thanks — i see HR-EXP-1827. Reimbursements: once receipts are approved by People Ops/Benefits they hit payroll queue. If approved before payroll cut-off (Fri 16:00 BST) it'll appear in the next cycle; otherwise the following cycle. Home-office stipend usually gets added to the next payment run; if it's not showing we can add a manual adjustment. ping with HR-EXP-1827 here if you want me to force it.
eli (New Hire): perfect. one more: any tax forms or cross-border docs i need to fill out as a UK employee? (i keep seeing W-8 stuff but i'm not a contractor)
ruth (People Ops): W-8 series is for non-US payees/contractors, not needed for UK employees. we'll run PAYE; you'll get a starter checklist (P45/P46 alternatives) and the UK tax onboarding doc. i'll DM you the opt-out waiver to e-sign for private health. welcome to the team! :tada:
